zh.title: 臺灣虎航發動機檢查逾期遭民航局裁罰20萬元
zh.summary: 臺灣虎航發動機檢查逾期，民航局裁罰新臺幣20萬元
body: 交通部民用航空局最新公佈的違規事件裁罰資訊指出，臺灣虎航一架A320-271N飛機的二號發動機燃燒室延遲缺點檢查管制逾期，依民航法遭裁罰新臺幣20萬元，並被要求立即改善。
臺灣虎航表示，該架註冊編號B-50023的航機去年9月執行航班調度時出現管制時間計算落差。公司在安全管理系統（SMS）自主查覈時發現後，當日完成發動機檢查並確認狀況符合安全規範，也立即向主管機關主動提報。臺灣虎航另表示，已針對事件檢討改善並加強雙重覆核機制。

en.title: Taiwan Tigerair fined NT$200,000 over overdue engine inspection
en.summary: Taiwan Tigerair was fined NT$200,000 after an engine inspection deadline was missed.
body: The Civil Aviation Administration’s latest published violation information says Taiwan Tigerair was fined NT$200,000 under the Civil Aviation Act after an inspection control deadline for the No. 2 engine’s combustion-chamber deferred defect passed. The authority also required immediate improvement.

Taiwan Tigerair said aircraft B-50023 had a discrepancy in the calculation of the control time during flight scheduling in September last year. The airline said its Safety Management System (SMS) self-audit identified the discrepancy. It completed the engine inspection that day, confirmed the condition met safety requirements and promptly reported the matter to the regulator. Taiwan Tigerair also said it reviewed the event, made improvements and strengthened its dual-check mechanism.

zh.title: 空中巴士A350-900ULR航程達9700海里 靠減輕零件非增油箱
zh.summary: Simple Flying報導：A350-900ULR航程9700海里；靠移除零件非增油箱達成
body: 空中巴士A350-900ULR機型的航程據報達到9,700海里。航空新聞網站Simple Flying於2026年10月26日發布報導，指出該機型的卓越航程並非單靠增加燃油容量達成，而是透過移除零件來減輕重量。
該報導說明，通常增加航程需要更多燃油，但A350-900ULR的例外表現歸因於「遠不止增加燃油」的因素。標題明確表示航程達到9,700海里是「因為移除零件，而非額外油箱」的結果。
Simple Flying進一步解釋，對於A350-900ULR而言，其所達到的卓越航程歸功於遠不只是增加燃油，凸顯了透過移除組件來延長航程的設計思路。

en.title: Airbus A350-900ULR Reaches 9,700 NM Range by Removing Parts, Not Adding Fuel Tanks
en.summary: Simple Flying reports A350-900ULR hits 9,700 NM range; achieved by removing parts not adding fuel tanks
body: Aviation news site Simple Flying reported on October 26, 2026, that the Airbus A350-900ULR has a reported range of 9,700 nautical miles, and that this exceptional range is achieved not merely by adding fuel capacity but by removing parts to reduce weight.

The report notes that typically more range requires more fuel, yet the A350-900ULR's performance is attributed to factors "far more than just added fuel." The headline explicitly states the range is reached "Because Parts Were Removed, Not Extra Fuel Tanks," emphasizing weight reduction over extra fuel tanks.

Simple Flying's summary further explains that for the A350-900ULR, the exceptional range it reaches is thanks to far more than just added fuel, highlighting the design approach of removing components to extend range.
